tools.name: get_workflow_guide
tools.description: Returns Nityaflow's workflow design guide: the JSON shape of a workflow, the design rules, and every step type with its settings (schedules, webhooks, WhatsApp, Google Sheets, Gmail, databases, HTTP requests, code, AI replies, checks, approvals, receipts, GST credit matching and client document chas

tools.name: create_workflow_draft
tools.description: Checks a Nityaflow workflow design and keeps it for 14 days behind a link. Opening the link shows the workflow in the Nityaflow editor with every step filled in and a safe test run; nothing runs or sends until the person reviews it and switches it on. Returns the link and the list of accounts the pe

tools.name: gst_credit_match
tools.description: India GST input tax credit check. Matches the supplier invoices in GSTR-2B against the purchase register from the books (Tally, Zoho Books, Busy, QuickBooks or any list) and sorts every invoice into: matched, amount mismatch, entered twice (duplicate bills), possible match (invoice number or GSTIN w

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Checks that a Nityaflow receipt was not changed and was signed by Nityaflow.

tools.name: agent_payment_check
tools.description: Before an AI agent pays, checks the proposed payment against the person's mandate (who allowed it, limits per payment and per period, allowed shops and UPI IDs, end date) and against what the person actually asked for (items, quantities, budget, shop). It works the total out again from the cart line

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_workflow_draft" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
